documents.title: Office Visit - Hypertension
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
BP f/u, school vacation week. Losartan 50 + HCTZ 25, no side effects. Home readings 130s-140s/80s. No headaches, vision changes or chest pain.
BP 145/88, HR 73, wt 70.2 kg. Regular rhythm. Breath sounds normal. No ankle swelling.
A/P: Renovascular HTN (R renal FMD), running in her usual range on two drugs. Continue. BMP today. Next: physical in the fall. Cardiology — still hasn't scheduled; feels well and doesn't want another specialist visit right now. Will revisit.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Per PCP: BMP normal — potassium 4.3, creatinine 0.71. No changes. Message sent to pt via portal.

documents.title: Refill Request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Refill request from pharmacy: losartan 50 mg and hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg, 90-day. Last BP visit 4/19/22 with normal BMP. Sent both with 3 refills per PCP.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL
39 y/o F. Doing well, end of first marking period, tired but otherwise fine. Home BP 130s-140s/80s.
Meds: losartan 50 mg daily, HCTZ 25 mg daily. NKDA.
Contraception: reliable, unchanged.
Prevention: flu today. Bivalent COVID booster 10/15 at pharmacy (entered). Pap/HPV due 2024. PHQ-2: 1 (tired) — no depressed mood or anhedonia on further questions.

Exam: BP 140/86, HR 87, T 36.3, SpO2 99%, wt 70.8 kg, BMI 25.8.
Pleasant, well. ENT normal. Thyroid normal size. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft. No edema. Skin unremarkable.

A/P
1. Renovascular HTN / R renal FMD — stable range. Continue regimen. BMP today.
2. Health maintenance as above.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PHYSICAL
40 y/o F, feels well. Home BP 130s-140s/80s. No headaches or vision changes.
Meds: losartan 50 mg, hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily. NKDA. Contraception unchanged; ARB/pregnancy counselling current.

Prevention:
- Flu today; updated COVID vaccine 10/7 at pharmacy (entered).
- Lipids today (last 2018).
- Pap/HPV due 2024.
- Mammography: discussed starting screening now that she's 40. She'd like to think about it and decide by next year.
- PHQ-2: 0.

Exam: BP 135/90, HR 77, T 36.6, SpO2 97%, wt 69.7 kg, BMI 25.4.
Well. ENT clear. Thyroid normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. No edema. Skin: no concerning lesions.

A/P
1. Renovascular HTN / R renal FMD — stable on two agents. BMP, lipids.
2. Health maintenance as above.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your labs are fine. Cholesterol: total 183, LDL 96, HDL 62, triglycerides 85 — similar to 2018. Potassium 4.2 and kidney function normal on losartan and HCTZ. No changes.
